note: Character-neutral GPT-ref sheet: 43 cells, every cell image-conditioned on the ref. All character words come from the spec (see plugins/factory/skills/character-sheet/SKILL.md). Select with the spec field 'template'. body_underlayer_front is generated from the ref, the other body cells use its output as base_layer_ref. Row keys: mirror_of marks a row made by flipping another row's png (tools/mirror_cell.py), the queue skips it. A per-row re-render seed lives in the spec field row_seeds {row_id: {seed, note}} and is emitted as the row's seed and seed_note. A swatch item with swatch_of {source_row, box (fractions), size} becomes a crop of an approved cell made by tools/swatch_crop.py; the queue skips rows with swatch_of. Optional spec fields (absent = output unchanged): head_age_desc, head_skin_desc, body_age_desc, body_skin_desc add 'Age and face / Skin / Build' sentences to the head, body and foot prompts; head_front_ref and head_lock_ref set the reference image of the identity-lock head rows. Optional spec fields gear_colour_rule (appended to every gear prompt) and palette fields such as coat_palette used inside item strings as {coat_palette}.

order_note: Emit order (GPU queue priority): identity cells, then the cells that feed 3D, then hands and feet, gear flats, swatches, close-ups last. An entry is a row_id or 'group:<group>'; a row_id entry beats its group entry; unlisted rows go last. Without 'order' the old group_priority applies.
